title: VtM5e Disciplines (Automated)
description: Standalone Disciplines compendium for Vampire the Masquerade 5e - the corebook power catalog, with item names corrected and resistance/description data pre-configured for vtm5e-automation's Automated Resistance system. Forked once from the vampire-the-masquerade-5e-compendium addon (via migrate-to-standalone-compendium.js) specifically so those fixes aren't at risk of being overwritten by a future update to that addon. Not published; built for personal use.
